chunks: Those who devour the possessions of the orphans unjustly devour only fire, and will surely burn in Hell.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of unjustly consuming orphan's wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the spiritual corruption inherent in devouring orphan wealth, linking the physical act of consumption to the internalization of divine fire. It serves as a stern warning to guardians (awliya) who neglect their fiduciary duties, emphasizing that such injustice is not merely a civil wrong but a path to Sa'ir, a specific tier of Hellfire reserved for those who transgress divine boundaries.
